exceptions.reason: Build-time only: expo 58 -> @expo/metro -> metro-file-map -> micromatch 4 -> braces 3. Metro uses it to match the project's own watch and ignore globs while bundling the mobile app; it is not shipped in the app and never sees untrusted patterns. braces 3.0.3 is the latest release, so no patched version exists.

The advisory concerns verifying RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signatures from others, which nothing here does with node-forge. The desktop app ships it only to create and sign the self-signed certificate of its peer identity (apps/desktop/src/main/peer/identity.ts); certificates are verified by Node's TLS against the certificate pinned at pairing. At build time, expo 58 -> @expo/cli (and @expo/code-signing-certificates) uses it for iOS signing identities and to sign update manifests, neither of which this repository configures. node-forge 1.4.0 is the latest release, so no patched version exists.
